Times of Israel live blog entry, 25 October 2026, 12:43 am (Israel time; ~21:43 GMT Sat 24 Oct). Direct curl 403'd; text retrieved via WebFetch rendering.

Headline: Trump says more strikes on Iran before midterms possible, but deal also possible

"Do you really think I'm going to tell you if I'm going to do it?" Trump responded when asked about the possibility of attacking Iran. He continued: "There's a possibility I will. There's also a possibility we'll have a nice, big, beautiful agreement."

Trump reiterated his belief that Iran seeks negotiations: "the problem is, will they hold the deal?"

The article notes that Trump had recently stated on social media he would not strike Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, though his public comments suggested both military action and diplomatic resolution remained possibilities.

Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accused the United States of disrupting negotiations, claiming Iran's supreme leader instructed officials to "go and finish" the deal, but that Washington "disrupted them."

The region braced for potential escalation before elections in both Israel and the United States.
